notes: n <= 0: raise ValueError vs return [] vs return [xs] (no split)
Trailing partial chunk: keep as-is vs drop vs pad with 0 to length n
Empty input: [] vs [[]] (always at least one chunk) vs n empty lists
n larger than len(xs): single chunk vs no chunks vs padded chunk
'chunks of size n' vs 'n chunks' (balanced split) reading of n
Whether returned inner lists are slices (copies) of xs or the same object when not split
